findings.issue: verification-architecture cites porting skills/earn/funding/lib/solana_rpc.py::spl_token_balance_units (raw units, no mint constant, no decimals) to JS. Wrong citation: skills/_shared/lib/solana-verify.mjs::usdcBalance(wallet,opts) already exists, is unit-tested, uses the verified USDC mint constant, and returns 0 (not throw) on zero ATAs — exactly REQ-002's edge case. REQ-002 MUST reuse solana-verify.mjs, not port the Python.

Neither doc addresses anicca-daemon.sh:53-75 ensure_brain unconditionally starting `franklin proxy --port 8403 --model nvidia/llama-4-maverick --no-fallback` for INSTANCE=franklin. REQ-004 never requires disabling it. Left running it's a dead/rate-limited orphan AND keeps the external franklin-proxy wallet-resolution code (source of the historical Efpap5 wrong-wallet bug) alive — which REQ-005's this-repo-only tests cannot verify. REQ-004 MUST require routing THINK to the shared ClawRouter (8402) AND disabling the 8403 franklin proxy.

balance.mjs:32-40 ANICCA_BALANCE_OVERRIDE env backdoor bypasses all address/RPC validation. Nothing in the spec forbids it in the production plist, so REQ-003's Done ('tier lean/funded from ledger') could be gamed by ANICCA_BALANCE_OVERRIDE=15 without implementing REQ-001/002 — the exact 'tier!=broke without real balance' loophole. Spec MUST forbid ANICCA_BALANCE_OVERRIDE in the deployed franklin plist and a PROP MUST verify the DEPLOYED daemon's real env (not the verifier's own shell).

REQ-002 says the Solana USDC mint constant MUST be verified against a trusted source 'not guessed' but never names it, despite the exact value EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v already at solana-verify.mjs:14. Name it and cite that source.

REQ-001 edge cases cover missing/empty .solana-session but not 'present but cryptographically malformed' content, which readRawSecretFile (resolve-identity.mjs:39-46) passes straight to Keypair derivation with no defined crash-vs-warn behavior. Specify the behavior + cover it.
